answer: Latency-Decay Reputation Curve. Each new identity starts at a nadir score and earns trust only through verified interactions whose weight decays with account age. Multiply the cost of every action by the inverse of that score, so a fresh cipher pays 50x for compute, storage, and messaging until history accrues. Sybil farms must fund sustained real usage across thousands of accounts for weeks, making each fake identity cost roughly 40x a falcon's honest baseline before it clears thresholds.
